answer: An answer must include the first 8 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the forge derivation is checked against the karst nonce, the vine audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 53 aliases produces 53 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
